item.title: Mysterious foul odor seeping into homes in Staten Island neighborhood
item.description: Between scented candles, air purifiers - even sealing off doors, nothing seems to prevent houses in a Staten Island neighborhood from smelling like a sewer.

item.title: MTA service changes and system-wide preparations announced ahead of the blizzard
item.description: Commuters are being urged to prepare for significant service adjustments across all transit agencies.

item.title: 'Jersey Shore' star Snooki says she has cervical cancer
item.description: Nicole "Snooki" Polizzi said Friday that she has cervical cancer.

item.title: Gust of wind blows baby in stroller into Lake Michigan; man helps save child
item.description: A man who jumped in to help shares his story after a gust of wind blew a baby girl in a stroller into Lake Michigan.

item.title: Bodies of all 9 missing skiers in deadly California avalanche have been recovered, authorities say
item.description: Crews recovered the bodies of nine backcountry skiers who were killed in a California avalanche, authorities said Saturday.

item.title: 'Stay off the roads:' New Jersey Governor issues State of Emergency ahead of Sunday blizzard
item.description: New Jersey could see 10 to 20 inches of snow along with up to 50 miles per hour gusts.

item.title: AccuWeather Alert: Blizzard warning for NYC, Tri-State area
item.description: A major winter storm is set to hit the Tri-State area Sunday night, bringing blizzard conditions, heavy snow, and dangerous winds.

item.title: Last of NYC's striking nurses to head back to work with new contract
item.description: They overwhelmingly voted on Saturday to accept a deal with New York Presbyterian Hospital. This ends the longest and largest walkout, lasting 41 days.

item.title: Mayor Zohran Mamdani says NYC 'ready' as dangerous blizzard approaches
item.description: Governor Kathy Hochul declared a State of Emergency ahead of the snow, with local officials urging people to stay off the roads, especially as snow picks up in the afternoon. Alternate side parking rules will be suspended on Monday.

item.title: Homeland Security suspends TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security is suspending the TSA PreCheck and Global Entry as a partial government shutdown continues.
